facts.text: Wesleyan University does not include loans in undergraduate financial aid packages, covering 100% of remaining demonstrated need across tuition, housing, books, supplies, and personal expenses.

sources.title: Affordability and Aid | Wesleyan University
sources.quote: We do not include loans in our undergraduate financial aid packages. We look at demonstrated need and families' expected contribution, then put together a financial aid package that covers 100% of the remaining tuition, housing, books, supplies, and personal expenses.

facts.text: Wesleyan University features an open curriculum where General Education Expectations provide a framework for exploration instead of a rigid set of requirements.

sources.title: Our Open Curriculum | Academics - Wesleyan University
sources.quote: Our open curriculum balances a strong academic foundation with the opportunity to create a unique-to-you combination of disciplines, fields, and subject matter areas.

sources.title: Our Open Curriculum | Academics - Wesleyan University
sources.quote: Our General Education Expectations provides a framework for exploration—instead of a rigid set of requirements that hem in your creativity and curiosity.
